parsed.explanation: The 2022 Constitutional Court ruling removed the direct criminalisation of gender expression — a genuine documented positive. But the dossier shows it changed little operationally: dress-code policing outlasted the ruling, official discrimination against trans people persisted at one year on, and no remedy infrastructure exists (no association, blocked LGBTQI+ information, censors). Article 193's sodomy offence is documented as enforced and expressly reaches a trans visitor read as same-sex under birth-sex status, carrying up to seven years with functioning hostile enforcement. Public-morality prosecutions, a prior arrest for 'looking too feminine', gender segregation, and HIV deportation of foreigners add visitor-facing exposure. Worst features sit at tiers 2–3 (state-tolerated policing plus an enforced statute with no recourse), not tier 1: no birth-sex facility rule or implemented entry screening is documented. Hostile law and society with thin recourse place this in High Risk.
